title: Petition of Boston Edison Company for approval and authorization by the Department of Public Utilities of the issuance and sale of not more than 1,000,000 shares of its authorized Common Stock having a par value of ten dollars ($10) per share pursuant to a Dividend Reinvestment and Common Stock Purchase Plan, the net proceeds from such issuance and sale to be used for capital expenditures for extensions, additions and improvements to the Company's utility plant and properties or to the payment of obligations of the Company incurred for such expenditures.
